citation: Reed KS, Crew MR, Frescoln AM, et al. Effects of a high‐sugar mixed meal on cerebrovascular haemodynamics in young, healthy versus middle‐aged adults with cardiometabolic risk factors. Experimental Physiology. 2025;111(4):2370-2383.
protocol: High-sugar mixed meal: nine Hostess mini donuts and Nesquik chocolate milk, 930 kcal (129 g carbohydrate, 100.5 g sugar, 35.5 g fat, 14 g protein) within 10 min. Blood at 0, 30, 60 min.
population: 21 young healthy adults (18-39 y, 24 ± 6 y) and 20 middle-aged adults (40-65 y, 55 ± 5 y) with cardiometabolic risk factors; USA (Massachusetts).
note: A large sugary Western meal with exact macronutrients; use the young healthy group. Insulin is in pg/mL (divide by ~5.8 for µU/mL). Only 60 min of follow-up. Meal kinds: mixed meal.
